Another recipe I like is bacon-wrapped bundles (for holidays only). Cut bacon strips in half, wrap a bundle of about 10 whole beans (fresh or frozen) in bacon. No need to toothpick, bacon will stick to itself. Place bundles with ends of bacon down on a baking sheet covered in foil. Mix Ott's Famous dressing with some horseradish (to taste) and pour over bundles. Bake/roast at 425F until bacon is cooked, about 20 minutes. It crisps up the ends of the beans nicely, and the sugar in the dressing caramelizes everything. Clean-up is easy because you just toss the foil. One serving is 2 bundles. A little sweet, a hint of spicy, and lots of savory, these things go fast at family dinners.
